scope: Local Docker and portable configuration only; no deployment or external provider sends

checks: Fresh migrations applied and reapplied without changes
Legacy item names and stock quantities retained
Opening stock ledger matches migrated inventory
Migration does not silently set passwords for existing users
Runtime role has normal application data access
Can append stock, audit and payment-event history
Cannot update or delete append-only history

databaseRecovery.method: Exported transaction snapshot, custom pg_dump archive, SHA-256 checksum and matching snapshot count manifest
checks: Snapshot counts match all seven tables

objectRecovery.source: Actual processed image uploaded during API acceptance tests
objectRecovery.verification: Per-object SHA-256 matched after restoration and re-download
objectRecovery.notes: The API image deletion test had removed image metadata; its deferred-cleanup object remained available for recovery verification. The isolated test cluster is intentionally disposable.

limits: Database and object exports are individually verified, not a cross-system atomic snapshot
Local backups do not replace encrypted off-host backups
Production provider recovery, certificate issuance and external alert delivery were not performed
Pinned archived MinIO is a development compatibility fixture only
